title: Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: Coverage Writing Schedule
content:
Coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is written on one piece at a time, and each plan in the family admits a piece only inside the item-value band, the purchase window and the entry conditions this schedule sets for it. The figures below are the coverage's own for each plan.

## Schedule

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entry condition | included with every purchase | bought within 30 days of the sale | bought within 30 days of the sale | bought within 60 days of the sale | bought within 60 days of the sale; a current appraisal on file | bought within 90 days of the sale; a current appraisal on file; underwriting review |
| Coverage term, whole months from the effective date | 12 | 24 | 36 | 60 | 0 (no fixed term) | 0 (no fixed term) |
| Coverage runs for as long as the customer owns the piece | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |
| Plan price as a percentage of the pre-tax item price | 0.0 percent | 8.5 percent | 11.0 percent | 14.5 percent | 19.0 percent | 24.0 percent |
| Smallest pre-tax item price the plan is written on | 99.00 USD | 299.00 USD | 499.00 USD | 999.00 USD | 2499.00 USD | 9999.00 USD |
| Largest pre-tax item price the plan is written on | 99999.00 USD | 9999.00 USD | 19999.00 USD | 39999.00 USD | 99999.00 USD | 499999.00 USD |
| Purchase window, calendar days after the sale of the piece | 0 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 90 |
| Waiting period, calendar days between buying the plan and coverage beginning | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 30 |
| Item value above which a current appraisal must be on file before the plan is written | 4999.00 USD | 4999.00 USD | 7499.00 USD | 9999.00 USD | 14999.00 USD | 24999.00 USD |
| Premium may be added to a promotional financing plan | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Plans of this coverage that may stand on one covered item at once | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

## Reading the schedule

- The coverage term is counted in whole months from the effective date; a term of 0 means the coverage does not run to a fixed term, and on those two plans the coverage runs for as long as the customer owns the piece.
- The plan price is a percentage of the pre-tax price the covered item sold at, so a plan whose price is 0.0 percent is written at no charge.
- The purchase window is the number of calendar days after the sale of the item within which the coverage may still be bought; the waiting period is the number of calendar days between buying the plan and the day coverage begins.
- Above the item value shown, a current appraisal must already be on file for the piece before the plan is written.

## Hypothetical selection reading

A customer asks, purely as an illustration, which plans of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans could be written on a piece that sold pre-tax at 1500.00 USD. The band test on this schedule admits the Belrose Care Plan 2-Year (299.00 to 9999.00 USD), the Belrose Care Plan 3-Year (499.00 to 19999.00 USD) and the Belrose Care Plan 5-Year (999.00 to 39999.00 USD); the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan does not, because 1500.00 USD is below its 2499.00 USD floor, and neither does the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan. The Manufacturer Limited Warranty, included with every purchase, admits any piece from 99.00 USD. Which of the admitted plans is actually written then turns on the purchase window and the other conditions of this schedule, read against the sale date.
